document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your  party  manages  to  wrestle  Ebstein  away  from  Norman. 
He topples over the side of the canoe. As the splash drenches 
your group, Bernard sinks into the swift current. For an instant 
you glimpse him, swimming with strange strokes near the dark 
bottom, and then nothing. Norman is scratched and shaken by 
the attack, but otherwise unharmed.
